senses.en: relating to the printing of text or the style and arrangement of type

example.en: The editor found several typographical errors in the manuscript.
example.zh: 编辑在手稿中发现了几处排印错误。

senses.en: the act of correcting something

example.en: The rectification of the error took only a few minutes.
example.zh: 这个错误的纠正只花了几分钟。

senses.en: conversion of alternating current to direct current (electronics)

example.en: The circuit performs rectification of the AC signal.
example.zh: 该电路对交流信号进行整流。

senses.en: to speak ambiguously to avoid committing to the truth

example.en: The witness equivocated when asked about the timeline.
example.zh: 被问到时间线时，证人含糊其辞。

senses.en: flying maneuvers such as loops and rolls performed for sport or display

example.en: The air show featured daring aerobatics by skilled pilots.
example.zh: 航空展上有技术精湛的飞行员表演惊险的特技飞行。

senses.en: a thin, crisp, usually unsweetened biscuit

example.en: He ate cheese and crackers as a snack.
example.zh: 他把奶酪和薄脆饼干当零食吃。

senses.en: (British) a small cardboard tube that pops open at Christmas, containing a small toy and paper hat

example.en: We pulled Christmas crackers at the dinner table.
example.zh: 我们在餐桌上拉了圣诞拉炮。

senses.en: feeling or showing sympathy for people who are suffering

example.en: The nurse was kind and compassionate with her patients.
example.zh: 这位护士对病人既亲切又有同情心。

senses.en: dead; no longer living, often used in formal or legal contexts

example.en: The deceased person's family attended the memorial.
example.zh: 逝者的家人参加了追悼会。

senses.en: a person who has died, used especially in legal contexts

example.en: The will of the deceased was read to the relatives.
example.zh: 死者的遗嘱向亲属宣读了。

senses.en: a covering of artificial or real hair worn on the head

example.en: The actor wore a wig for the period drama.
example.zh: 那位演员拍历史剧时戴了假发。

senses.en: to bend a limb or muscle, especially to show strength

example.en: He flexed his arm to show off his muscles.
example.zh: 他屈起手臂炫耀肌肉。

senses.en: to bend or allow something to bend without breaking

example.en: The new material can flex without cracking.
example.zh: 这种新材料能弯曲而不会开裂。

senses.en: (British) a flexible electrical cable; also, an act of flexing

example.en: The lamp's flex was damaged and had to be replaced.
example.zh: 台灯的电线坏了，必须更换。

senses.en: the beginning of something

example.en: The company has grown steadily since its inception in 2010.
example.zh: 该公司自2010年成立以来稳步发展。

senses.en: to take in a liquid, gas, heat, or other substance

example.en: The sponge absorbs water quickly.
example.zh: 海绵能迅速吸水。

senses.en: to understand and remember information or ideas
senses.zh: 理解并掌握（信息或想法）

example.en: It takes time to absorb new information.
example.zh: 吸收新信息需要时间。

senses.en: to hold someone's attention completely

example.en: She was absorbed in her book.
example.zh: 她全神贯注地看书。

senses.en: to officially choose someone for a job or position
senses.zh: 正式任命（某人担任职位）

example.en: The board appointed her as the new director.
example.zh: 董事会任命她为新任董事。

senses.en: to formally decide and set a time, date, or place
senses.zh: 正式确定（时间、日期或地点）

example.en: We must appoint a time for the next meeting.
example.zh: 我们必须确定下次会议的时间。

senses.en: not easy to notice or understand because it is slight or indirect

example.en: The changes in the policy were subtle but important.
example.zh: 政策的变化虽然微妙，但很重要。

senses.en: showing fine judgment or delicate understanding

example.en: She has a subtle understanding of human emotions.
example.zh: 她对人的情感有敏锐的理解。

senses.en: delicate and skillfully made or arranged

example.en: The director uses subtle lighting to create mood.
example.zh: 导演用细腻的灯光营造氛围。

senses.en: a system of voting, especially when votes are secret

example.en: The union decided to hold a ballot on the new contract.
example.zh: 工会决定就新合同举行投票。

senses.en: the paper or electronic list used to record a vote

example.en: She marked her choices on the ballot and placed it in the box.
example.zh: 她在选票上标记了自己的选择，然后把它投入票箱。

senses.en: to vote, especially by secret ballot

example.en: Members will ballot on whether to accept the offer.
example.zh: 成员将就是否接受该提议进行投票。

senses.en: a set of different things of the same general type

example.en: The store sells a wide range of products.
example.zh: 这家商店出售各种各样的产品。

senses.en: the distance within which something can work or be effective

example.en: The radio has a range of about ten kilometers.
example.zh: 这台收音机的有效范围约为十公里。

senses.en: to vary between two or more amounts or levels

example.en: Prices range from ten to fifty dollars.
example.zh: 价格从十美元到五十美元不等。

collocations: range from ten to fifty dollars

senses.en: the larger part of a group or the greater number of people or things

example.en: The majority of students agreed with the plan.
example.zh: 大多数学生同意这个计划。

senses.en: more than half of the votes in an election

example.en: The candidate won a majority of the votes.
example.zh: 这位候选人赢得了多数选票。

senses.en: the age at which a person legally becomes an adult

example.en: She reached the age of majority last year.
example.zh: 她去年达到了法定成年年龄。

senses.en: the power to affect people or events

example.en: The book had a strong influence on her thinking.
example.zh: 这本书对她的思想有很大影响。

senses.en: to affect someone or something

example.en: Parents can influence a child's habits.
example.zh: 父母能影响孩子的习惯。

senses.en: a person or thing that affects someone or something

example.en: She is a positive influence on the team.
example.zh: 她对团队有积极的影响。

senses.en: the state or fact of being real or present

example.en: Scientists have not confirmed the existence of life on other planets.
example.zh: 科学家尚未证实其他星球上存在生命。

senses.en: a person's life or way of living, especially when difficult

example.en: For many families, daily existence remains a struggle.
example.zh: 对许多家庭来说，日常生活仍然是一场挣扎。

senses.en: a group officially appointed to investigate or manage a matter
senses.zh: 委员会；调查或管理某事务的官方团体

example.en: The government set up a commission to investigate the accident.
example.zh: 政府成立了一个委员会调查这起事故。

senses.en: money paid to an agent as a percentage of a sale or service
senses.zh: 佣金；按销售额或服务金额的一定比例支付给代理人的报酬

example.en: The agent earns a commission on each sale.
example.zh: 代理人从每笔销售中赚取佣金。

senses.en: to officially order or request a piece of work
senses.zh: 委托制作；正式订购或请人完成某作品

example.en: The city commissioned a new sculpture for the park.
example.zh: 市政府委托为公园创作一座新雕塑。

senses.en: physically weak and delicate

example.en: The old man looked frail after his long illness.
example.zh: 长期患病后，这位老人看上去很虚弱。

senses.en: easily broken or damaged; not strong

example.en: The chair was so frail that it broke under his weight.
example.zh: 这把椅子非常不结实，他一坐就塌了。

senses.en: lacking in moral strength or willpower (formal or literary)

example.en: Human beings are frail and often make mistakes.
example.zh: 人是意志薄弱的，常常会犯错。

senses.en: (especially British English) a sweet, soft dessert that holds its shape and shakes when moved

example.en: The children had jelly and ice cream for dessert.
example.zh: 孩子们甜点吃了果冻和冰淇淋。

senses.en: a clear, firm fruit preserve made from juice and sugar

example.en: She spread strawberry jelly on her toast.
example.zh: 她在吐司上抹了草莓果酱。

senses.en: to become or make something become a jelly-like consistency

example.en: Let the mixture jelly in the fridge overnight.
example.zh: 让混合物在冰箱里过夜凝结成冻。

senses.en: to make something last longer

example.en: The doctor's treatment can prolong the patient's life.
example.zh: 医生的治疗可以延长病人的生命。

senses.en: a man who does manual or industrial labor

example.en: A skilled workman repaired the roof in two days.
example.zh: 一名熟练的工人两天内修好了屋顶。

senses.en: a slow-moving land reptile with a hard shell; also a person who moves or acts very slowly

example.en: The tortoise crawled slowly across the garden.
example.zh: 那只陆龟慢悠悠地爬过花园。

senses.en: a small plant with purple, blue or white flowers

example.en: Wild violets grew along the path.
example.zh: 野紫罗兰沿着小路生长。

senses.en: a color between blue and purple in the spectrum

example.en: She painted the sky in shades of violet.
example.zh: 她用深浅不同的紫罗兰色画天空。

senses.en: of a bluish-purple color

example.en: He wore a violet scarf.
example.zh: 他戴了一条紫罗兰色的围巾。

senses.en: having many bright or varied colors
senses.zh: 色彩鲜艳的；多姿多彩的

example.en: The garden is colorful in summer.
example.zh: 这座花园在夏天色彩缤纷。

senses.en: full of variety, interest, or excitement
senses.zh: 丰富多彩的；生动有趣的

example.en: He told stories about his colorful career.
example.zh: 他讲述了自己丰富多彩的职业生涯的故事。

senses.en: feeling very sad and without hope

example.en: He felt depressed after failing the exam.
example.zh: 考试不及格后他感到沮丧。

senses.en: past tense and past participle of depress; to lower or press down
senses.zh: 降低；使沮丧（depress的过去式和过去分词）

example.en: Falling demand depressed prices last year.
example.zh: 需求下降压低了价格。

senses.en: a massive stone structure with a square base and sloping sides, especially one built in ancient Egypt

example.en: The Great Pyramid of Giza is over 4,500 years old.
example.zh: 吉萨大金字塔已有四千五百多年的历史。

senses.en: a solid shape with a polygonal base and triangular sides that meet at a point

example.en: The children built a pyramid out of wooden blocks.
example.zh: 孩子们用积木搭了一个金字塔形状。

senses.en: a card with a picture on one side that is sent by mail without an envelope

example.en: She sent me a postcard from her holiday.
example.zh: 她度假时给我寄了一张明信片。

senses.en: showing good practical judgment; based on ordinary good sense

example.en: Her commonsense approach solved the problem quickly.
example.zh: 她合乎常理的处事方法很快解决了问题。

senses.en: an expression of pleasure at someone's success or good fortune; usually used in the plural

example.en: Congratulations on your graduation!
example.zh: 恭喜你毕业！

senses.en: the act of congratulating someone

example.en: He received a message of congratulation from his manager.
example.zh: 他收到了经理的贺信。

senses.en: the number 5

example.en: She bought five apples at the market.
example.zh: 她在市场上买了五个苹果。

senses.en: the digit or symbol 5; a group of five people or things

example.en: Write a five at the end of the number.
example.zh: 在这个数字的末尾写一个五。

senses.en: a basketball or sports team of five players (usually 'the five')

example.en: He was the best player on the school's starting five.
example.zh: 他是学校首发五人中最出色的球员。

senses.en: weighing a lot; having great weight

example.en: This suitcase is too heavy for me to carry.
example.zh: 这个行李箱太重了，我拿不动。

senses.en: great in degree, quantity or intensity

example.en: There was heavy traffic on the highway this morning.
example.zh: 今天早上高速公路上交通拥堵严重。

senses.en: in a heavy way; heavily (literary, in fixed expressions)
senses.zh: 沉重地（书面语，用于固定搭配）

example.en: The guilt lay heavy on his conscience.
example.zh: 负罪感沉重地压在他的良心上。

senses.en: fast; done or happening in a short time

example.en: She gave a quick reply to my question.
example.zh: 她迅速回答了我的问题。

senses.en: able to learn or understand things fast

example.en: He is a quick learner and picked up the skill in days.
example.zh: 他学得很快，几天就掌握了这项技能。

senses.en: quickly; without delay (informal)

example.en: Come quick, I need your help!
example.zh: 快来，我需要你帮忙！

senses.en: a climbing plant that produces grapes

example.en: The grapevines grow along the sunny wall.
example.zh: 葡萄藤沿着向阳的墙生长。

senses.en: the passing of news and gossip informally from person to person
senses.zh: 小道消息；谣言传播渠道

example.en: I heard through the grapevine that the office is closing.
example.zh: 我通过小道消息听说办公室要关了。

senses.en: brief and to the point, sometimes in a cold way

example.en: He gave a terse reply and hung up.
example.zh: 他简短生硬地回答了一句就挂了电话。

senses.en: remaining in its natural or original good condition; not damaged

example.en: The island's beaches are still unspoiled.
example.zh: 这个岛的海滩依然未遭破坏。

senses.en: not spoiled by being given everything; not overindulged

example.en: Despite their wealth, their children are unspoiled.
example.zh: 尽管他们很富有，孩子们却没有被宠坏。

senses.en: a gland in the neck that controls the body's metabolism

example.en: The doctor checked her thyroid because she felt tired all the time.
example.zh: 因为她一直觉得疲惫，医生检查了她的甲状腺。

senses.en: relating to the thyroid gland

example.en: He has a thyroid disorder that affects his energy levels.
example.zh: 他患有一种影响精力水平的甲状腺疾病。

senses.en: a state of fear or nervous depression

example.en: He's been in a funk since losing his job.
example.zh: 失业后他一直情绪低落。

senses.en: a style of popular dance music with a strong rhythmic groove
senses.zh: 放克音乐（节奏强烈的流行舞曲）

example.en: The band played classic funk from the 1970s.
example.zh: 乐队演奏了二十世纪七十年代的经典放克音乐。

senses.en: weak and likely to shake or collapse

example.en: They climbed the rickety old stairs carefully.
example.zh: 他们小心地爬上摇摇晃晃的旧楼梯。

senses.en: the part at the end of the leg that you stand on

example.en: He injured his left foot while running.
example.zh: 他跑步时伤了左脚。

senses.en: a unit of length equal to 12 inches (about 30.5 cm)

example.en: The table is three feet wide.
example.zh: 这张桌子宽三英尺。

senses.en: the bottom or lower end of something

example.en: We camped at the foot of the mountain.
example.zh: 我们在山脚下露营。

senses.en: to pay a bill or cost

example.en: Her company footed the bill for the trip.
example.zh: 她的公司支付了这次旅行的费用。

senses.en: a person receiving medical care

example.en: The patient waited quietly in the clinic.
example.zh: 那位病人在诊所里安静地等候。

senses.en: able to wait or accept difficulty calmly

example.en: She was patient with the slow learner.
example.zh: 她对那个学得慢的人很有耐心。

senses.en: done on purpose; intentional

example.en: The fire was deliberate, not an accident.
example.zh: 这场火灾是蓄意的，不是意外。

senses.en: carefully thought out; slow and careful
senses.zh: 深思熟虑的；从容不迫的

example.en: She spoke in a slow, deliberate way.
example.zh: 她说话缓慢而从容。

senses.en: to think about or discuss something carefully before deciding

example.en: The jury deliberated for three hours before reaching a verdict.
example.zh: 陪审团商议了三个小时才作出裁决。

senses.en: to move up and down or from side to side quickly and loosely

example.en: The bird flapped its wings and flew away.
example.zh: 那只鸟拍打着翅膀飞走了。

senses.en: a piece of material that hangs loose and can be lifted, attached at one edge

example.en: The flap of the envelope was not sealed.
example.zh: 信封的封口没有粘上。

senses.en: a state of excitement, worry, or confusion (informal)

example.en: There was quite a flap when the report was lost.
example.zh: 报告丢失时大家非常慌乱。

senses.en: brave; able to face danger or fear without backing down

example.en: The courageous firefighter ran back into the building to save the child.
example.zh: 那位勇敢的消防员冲回大楼去救那个孩子。

senses.en: a reduction in the usual price of something

example.en: Students get a discount on train tickets.
example.zh: 学生购买火车票有折扣。

senses.en: to reduce the price of something

example.en: The store discounts all winter clothes in spring.
example.zh: 这家商店在春季给所有冬装打折。

senses.en: to regard something as unlikely or unimportant; to dismiss it

example.en: Experts discount rumors about the company closing.
example.zh: 专家们不相信有关公司要倒闭的传言。

senses.en: the act of turning around a central point or axis

example.en: The planet's rotation takes about 24 hours.
example.zh: 这颗行星自转一周大约需要24小时。

senses.en: taking turns in a regular order

example.en: The team members work the night shift in rotation.
example.zh: 队员们轮流上夜班。

senses.en: not needed; more than is required

example.en: Buying a second car seemed unnecessary.
example.zh: 买第二辆车似乎没有必要。

senses.en: to save goods or property from damage or destruction

example.en: Divers salvaged some cargo from the sunken ship.
example.zh: 潜水员从沉船中打捞出一些货物。

senses.en: goods saved from damage, or the act of saving them
senses.zh: 抢救出的财物；打捞；救助

example.en: The salvage from the wreck was sold at auction.
example.zh: 沉船打捞出的财物被拍卖了。

senses.en: having a strong smell; smelling of something

example.en: The kitchen was redolent of fresh bread.
example.zh: 厨房里弥漫着新鲜面包的香味。

senses.en: evoking or bringing to mind something

example.en: The old song was redolent of his college years.
example.zh: 这首老歌令他想起大学时光。

senses.en: too good or unusual to be copied; unique

example.en: She entertained the guests with her inimitable style.
example.zh: 她以独具一格的风格招待宾客。

senses.en: too eager to obey others and serve them; slavish
senses.zh: 奴颜婢膝的；卑躬屈节的

example.en: He gave the manager a servile smile and agreed with everything she said.
example.zh: 他冲经理谄媚地笑了笑，对她说的一切都表示赞同。

senses.en: relating to slaves or servant-like work

example.en: In the novel, prisoners were forced to do servile labor.
example.zh: 在小说中，囚犯被迫做奴仆般的苦工。

senses.en: unable to stop doing something because of a strong inner urge

example.en: He is a compulsive gambler who cannot stop betting.
example.zh: 他是一个无法停止下注的强迫性赌徒。

senses.en: very interesting so that you cannot stop watching or reading
senses.zh: 引人入胜的，让人欲罢不能的

example.en: The series turned out to be compulsive viewing.
example.zh: 这部剧成了让人欲罢不能的电视节目。

senses.en: a person who feels a strong need to do certain things

example.en: The clinic helps compulsives overcome their habits.
example.zh: 这家诊所帮助有强迫行为的人克服他们的习惯。

senses.en: full of fog or covered with fog

example.en: The road is dangerous on foggy nights.
example.zh: 雾夜在这条路上开车很危险。

senses.en: not clear; confused or vague

example.en: He had only a foggy memory of the accident.
example.zh: 他对那次事故只有模糊的记忆。

senses.en: a loud, persistent noise made by many people

example.en: The clamour of the crowd grew louder before the concert.
example.zh: 音乐会开始前，人群的喧闹声越来越大。

senses.en: to shout or demand loudly and persistently

example.en: Protesters clamoured for immediate change.
example.zh: 抗议者大声要求立即变革。

senses.en: more than needed; unnecessary

example.en: Cut any superfluous words from the essay.
example.zh: 删掉文章中多余的词句。

senses.en: capable of being educated or taught

example.en: Teachers believe every child is educable.
example.zh: 教师们相信每个孩子都是可教育的。

senses.en: using authority in a bossy, unfair way without considering others

example.en: People complained about the manager's highhanded handling of the dispute.
example.zh: 人们抱怨经理专横地处理这场纠纷。

senses.en: particular methods of doing something

example.en: Farmers are learning new irrigation techniques.
example.zh: 农民们正在学习新的灌溉技术。

senses.en: skill in performing an activity

example.en: Her piano technique improved with daily practice.
example.zh: 每天的练习让她的钢琴技巧提高了。
